title: Restaurant with alcohol, new business in an existing building — Viejo San Juan historic zone (autonomous)
description: We are opening a restaurant with a full bar in a leased colonial building in Old San Juan. No construction; we will add a new sign over the door.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado). (KB: RULE_0651)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises (Q_PHYSICAL_LOCATION) -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0007)
Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / Q_ALCOHOL_SERVED -> Hacienda alcohol license. (KB: RULE_0013/0014)
Restaurant prepares food -> Licencia Sanitaria. (KB: RULE_0009)

Pin inside the Zona Histórica de San Juan: Ley 374-1949 Art. 1 requires the ICP's written recommendation before the use permit; RC-2023 Sec. 10.2.11.5 also lists signs and alcohol sales. (KB: RULE_0730)
San Juan administers a delegation agreement (Jer. I-III, OE-2021-061): the municipal permits office evaluates the use permit.
